title: 🕵️ Grammar Detective
description: Найди ошибку, исправь её, выбери правило и задай вопрос к предложению.

items.wrongExplanation: После He нужен помощник is: He is playing football now.

items.text: She read a book at the moment.
items.wrongExplanation: at the moment — это Present Continuous: She is reading a book.

fixOptions.text: She is reading a book at the moment.
She reads a book at the moment.
She are reading a book at the moment.

questions.text: Is she reading a book at the moment?
Does she reading a book at the moment?
Do she read a book at the moment?

items.wrongExplanation: С We глагол без -s: We watch TV every evening.

fixOptions.text: We are watching TV every evening.

explanations.text: Present Simple с I/you/we/they: глагол без -s.
Present Simple с he/she/it: глагол с -s.

questions.text: Do we watch TV every evening?
Does we watch TV every evening?
Are we watch TV every evening?

items.text: I am go to school every morning.
items.wrongExplanation: every morning — это Present Simple: I go to school.

fixOptions.text: I go to school every morning.
I am go to school every morning.
I goes to school every morning.

explanations.text: Present Simple с I: глагол без -s, am не нужен.
Present Continuous: I am + глагол с -ing.

questions.text: Do I go to school every morning?
Does I go to school every morning?
Am I go to school every morning?
